data.title: 火打谷爱衣 · 冰饮贴颊后的直球告白
data.description: 夜跑结束后无人的街心长椅旁，少年从背后将冰镇苏打水罐轻贴在爱衣发烫的脸颊上。爱衣发出一声可爱的惊呼，随后转过身抢过易拉罐，顺势拉近两人的距离。在夜风的吹拂下，她咬了咬牙，第一次毫无保留地说出了藏了整整一年的心意。
data.action: holding cold soda can to cheek, pulling close, earnest confession
data.lighting: streetlamp casting soft golden pool of light
data.promptProse: Resting beside a night park bench after jogging, Hiuchidani Mei holds a chilled soda can against her flushed cheek. She suddenly tugs the viewer closer by their collar under the streetlight, her violet eyes blazing with courageous, heartfelt passion.
data.animaCaption: Mei pulling close with brave confession under the park streetlight.
